scope: Read-only lexical audit of allocation-near-memcpy fixed/copy paths; lexical matches are not reachability or runtime qualification

sites.text:
br i1 %fits, label %done, label %grow
        grow:
          %doubled = shl i64 %old_capacity, 1
          %doubled_enough = icmp uge i64 %doubled, %end
          %new_capacity = select i1 %doubled_enough, i64 %doubled, i64 %end
          %new_data = call ptr @sollang_alloc(i64 %new_capacity)
          %allocated = icmp ne ptr %new_data, null
          br i1 %allocated, label %copy, label %allocation_failed
        copy:
          %old_data = load ptr, ptr %data_addr, align 1
          call void @llvm.memcpy.p0.p0.i64(ptr %new_data, ptr %old_data, i64 %used, i1 false)
          call void @sollang_free(ptr %old_data)
          store ptr %new_data, ptr %data_addr, align 1
          store i64 %new_capacity, ptr %capacity_addr, align 8

"heap$(callIndex -> valueNameId(state))_grow:" -> println
        "  %heap$(callIndex -> valueNameId(state))_capacity_zero = icmp eq i64 %heap$(callIndex -> valueNameId(state))_capacity, 0" -> println
        "  %heap$(callIndex -> valueNameId(state))_doubled = mul i64 %heap$(callIndex -> valueNameId(state))_capacity, 2" -> println
        "  %heap$(callIndex -> valueNameId(state))_grown_capacity = select i1 %heap$(callIndex -> valueNameId(state))_capacity_zero, i64 1, i64 %heap$(callIndex -> valueNameId(state))_doubled" -> println
        "  %heap$(callIndex -> valueNameId(state))_grown_bytes = mul i64 %heap$(callIndex -> valueNameId(state))_grown_capacity, $elementSize" -> println
        "  %heap$(callIndex -> valueNameId(state))_grown_data = call ptr @sollang_alloc(i64 %heap$(callIndex -> valueNameId(state))_grown_bytes)" -> println
        Arena(0) => allocationNames!
        "heap$(callIndex -> valueNameId(state))" -> materialize(allocationNames!)
            -> emitAllocationGuard("_grown_data", ownerIndex, context, state)
        "  %heap$(callIndex -> valueNameId(state))_copy_bytes = mul i64 %heap$(callIndex -> valueNameId(state))_length, $elementSize" -> println
        "  call void @llvm.memcpy.p0.p0.i64(ptr %heap$(callIndex -> valueNameId(state))_grown_data, ptr %heap$(callIndex -> valueNameId(state))_data, i64 %heap$(callIndex -> valueNameId(state))_copy_bytes, i1 false)" -> println
        "  call void @sollang_free(ptr %heap$(callIndex -> valueNameId(state))_data)" -> println
        "  br label %heap$(callIndex -> valueNameId(state))_ready" -> println
        "heap$(callIndex -> valueNameId(state))_ready:" -> println

"  %v$(regionNodeIndex -> valueNameId(state))_field$(regionFieldPosition!)_length = extractvalue %sollang.int_slice %v$(regionNodeIndex -> valueNameId(state))_field$(regionFieldPosition!)_copy_source, 1" -> println
                                context.typeSizes[regionTargetFieldTypeId!] => regionFieldAllocationBytes!
                                regionFieldAllocationBytes! == 0 -> if {
                                    context.typeSizes[context.types[regionTargetFieldTypeId!].first] => regionFieldAllocationBytes!
                                }
                                "  %v$(regionNodeIndex -> valueNameId(state))_field$(regionFieldPosition!)_owned = call ptr @sollang_alloc(i64 $(regionFieldAllocationBytes!))" -> println
                                "v$(regionNodeIndex -> valueNameId(state))_field$(regionFieldPosition!)" -> emitAllocationGuard("_owned", ownerIndex, context, state)
                                "  call void @llvm.memcpy.p0.p0.i64(ptr %v$(regionNodeIndex -> valueNameId(state))_field$(regionFieldPosition!)_owned, ptr %v$(regionNodeIndex -> valueNameId(state))_field$(regionFieldPosition!)_source, i64 $(context.typeSizes[regionTargetFieldTypeId!]), i1 false)" -> println
                                "  %v$(regionNodeIndex -> valueNameId(state))_field$(regionFieldPosition!)_copy0 = insertvalue %sollang.int_slice poison, ptr %v$(regionNodeIndex -> valueNameId(state))_field$(regionFieldPosition!)_owned, 0" -> println
                                "  %v$(regionNodeIndex -> valueNameId(state))_field$(regionFieldPosition!)_copy = insertvalue %sollang.int_slice %v$(regionNodeIndex -> valueNameId(state))_field$(regionFieldPosition!)_copy0, i64 %v$(regionNodeIndex -> valueNameId(state))_field$(regionFieldPosition!)_length, 1" -> println
                            }
                    }
                regionFieldValue.nextOperand => regionNextFieldValue!
                regionIndexedFieldValue! and regionNextFieldValue! >= 0

valueIndex -> fixedBranchTransferredBacking(branchRegion, context, state) => transferredBacking
                    transferredBacking < 0 -> if {
                        "  %if$(ifIndex -> valueNameId(state))_fixed$(branchOrdinal)_source = extractvalue %sollang.int_slice " -> print
                        valueIndex -> writeValue(ownerIndex, context, state)
                        ", 0" -> println
                        "  %if$(ifIndex -> valueNameId(state))_fixed$(branchOrdinal)_data = call ptr @sollang_alloc(i64 $(context.typeSizes[resultNode.typeId]))" -> println
                        "if$(ifIndex -> valueNameId(state))_fixed$(branchOrdinal)" -> emitAllocationGuard("_data", ownerIndex, context, state)
                        "  call void @llvm.memcpy.p0.p0.i64(ptr %if$(ifIndex -> valueNameId(state))_fixed$(branchOrdinal)_data, ptr %if$(ifIndex -> valueNameId(state))_fixed$(branchOrdinal)_source, i64 $(context.typeSizes[resultNode.typeId]), i1 false)" -> println
                        "  %if$(ifIndex -> valueNameId(state))_fixed$(branchOrdinal)_0 = insertvalue %sollang.int_slice poison, ptr %if$(ifIndex -> valueNameId(state))_fixed$(branchOrdinal)_data, 0" -> println
                        "  %if$(ifIndex -> valueNameId(state))_fixed$(branchOrdinal) = insertvalue %sollang.int_slice %if$(ifIndex -> valueNameId(state))_fixed$(branchOrdinal)_0, i64 $(context.types[resultNode.typeId].length), 1" -> println
                        true => fixedBranchCopied!
                    }
                }
            resultNode -> integerNodeWidth(context, state) => resultWidth

emittedFieldIndex -> writeAggregateOperand(functionIndex, whileIndex, context, state)
                        ", 1" -> println
                        context.typeSizes[targetFieldTypeId!] => fieldAllocationBytes!
                        fieldAllocationBytes! == 0
                            -> if { context.typeSizes[context.types[targetFieldTypeId!].first] => fieldAllocationBytes! }
                        "  %v$(expressionIndex -> valueNameId(state))_field$(fieldPosition!)_owned = call ptr @sollang_alloc(i64 $(fieldAllocationBytes!))" -> println
                        "v$(expressionIndex -> valueNameId(state))_field$(fieldPosition!)" -> emitAllocationGuard("_owned", functionIndex, context, state)
                        "  call void @llvm.memcpy.p0.p0.i64(ptr %v$(expressionIndex -> valueNameId(state))_field$(fieldPosition!)_owned, ptr %v$(expressionIndex -> valueNameId(state))_field$(fieldPosition!)_source, i64 $(context.typeSizes[targetFieldTypeId!]), i1 false)" -> println
                        "  %v$(expressionIndex -> valueNameId(state))_field$(fieldPosition!)_copy0 = insertvalue %sollang.int_slice poison, ptr %v$(expressionIndex -> valueNameId(state))_field$(fieldPosition!)_owned, 0" -> println
                        "  %v$(expressionIndex -> valueNameId(state))_field$(fieldPosition!)_copy = insertvalue %sollang.int_slice %v$(expressionIndex -> valueNameId(state))_field$(fieldPosition!)_copy0, i64 %v$(expressionIndex -> valueNameId(state))_field$(fieldPosition!)_length, 1" -> println
                    }
                targetFieldTypeId! >= 0 and context.types[targetFieldTypeId!].kind == 12 => boundedField
                boundedField -> if {
                    "v$(expressionIndex -> valueNameId(state))_field$(fieldPosition!)_bounded" -> emitBoundedArrayValue(emittedFieldIndex, functionIndex, targetFieldTypeId!, context, state)

valueIndex -> fixedArrayReturnNeedsPromotion(ownerIndex, context, state)
        -> unless { false -> return }
    "  %return_fixed$(nameRoot)_source = extractvalue %sollang.int_slice " -> print
    valueIndex -> writeValue(ownerIndex, context, state)
    ", 0" -> println
    "  %return_fixed$(nameRoot)_data = call ptr @sollang_alloc(i64 $(context.typeSizes[typeId]))" -> println
    "return_fixed$(nameRoot)" -> emitAllocationGuard("_data", ownerIndex, context, state)
    "  call void @llvm.memcpy.p0.p0.i64(ptr %return_fixed$(nameRoot)_data, ptr %return_fixed$(nameRoot)_source, i64 $(context.typeSizes[typeId]), i1 false)" -> println
    "  %return_fixed$(nameRoot)_0 = insertvalue %sollang.int_slice poison, ptr %return_fixed$(nameRoot)_data, 0" -> println
    "  %return_fixed$(nameRoot) = insertvalue %sollang.int_slice %return_fixed$(nameRoot)_0, i64 $(context.types[typeId].length), 1" -> println
    true
}

                request -> writeEnumStoragePayload(interpolationNodes, context, state)
                ", 1" -> println
                "  " -> print
                request -> writeEnumStorageIdentity("_payload_copy_data", state)
                " = call ptr @sollang_alloc(i64 $(context.typeSizes[request.payloadTypeId]))" -> println
                Arena(0) => copyNames!
                (request.resultDomain == 1 -> if {
                    "v$(request.labelIndex -> valueNameId(state))_expression$(request.resultIndex)_payload_copy" -> materialize(copyNames!)
                } else { "v$(request.resultIndex -> valueNameId(state))_payload_copy" -> materialize(copyNames!) }) => copyPrefix
                copyPrefix -> emitAllocationGuard("_data", request.ownerIndex, context, state)
                "  call void @llvm.memcpy.p0.p0.i64(ptr " -> print
                request -> writeEnumStorageIdentity("_payload_copy_data", state)
                ", ptr " -> print
